programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs

programme.title: Deadly Dinosaurs

programme.title: Imperative Life Lessons
programme.desc: In this powerful episode of Imperative Life Lessons, Pastor Ryan Johnson takes us to Revelation chapters 19–21 to explore the hope of the New Earth and the final eradication of sin. Through Scripture and a gripping real-life story of rescue from a burning house, we discover a profound truth: the fire was never prepared for us. Hell is separation from God, but Christ has done everything necessary to deliver us from both separation and destruction. This message is a reminder that no matter how intense the flames feel, Jesus fights for our rescue.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In The True Identity, Dr. Mark Sandoval explains how freedom, love, and stability flow from understanding who we truly are. Humanity’s fallen nature assumes the role of god—self-owned, self-sustaining, and self-defending—while God’s original design identifies us as His children: dependent, secure, and free. This episode shows what it looks like to live that identity in practical relationships, parenting, marriage, loss, injustice, and suffering. Using vivid illustrations, Dr. Sandoval demonstrates how having God as our only source frees us from manipulation, fear, control, and taking life personally. He contrasts stewardship with ownership, revealing why loss only devastates when we believe something belonged to us. The message also reframes suffering as a “talent” God uses to extend comfort and redemption to others. By grounding identity in God’s character and love, this presentation offers a pathway to contentment, resilience, and unselfish love that remains steady regardless of circumstances.

programme.title: Spotless
programme.desc: In Episode 7 of SPOTLESS, Shelley Quinn takes us through the rest of the biblical account of the great patriarchs of Genesis. Your eyes will be opened to understand why Abraham (and the strapping young Isaac) had the faith to submit to God’s strange request of human sacrifice that was purely a test of loyalty. Follow the twists and turns of the dramatic life accounts of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph, and see how God’s gracious intervention helped them endure hardships, and brought them into covenant relationship with Him so that they could inherit His blessings. The lives of the patriarchs reverberate with lessons for our generation.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In The True Identity, Dr. Mark Sandoval explains how freedom, love, and stability flow from understanding who we truly are. Humanity’s fallen nature assumes the role of god—self-owned, self-sustaining, and self-defending—while God’s original design identifies us as His children: dependent, secure, and free. This episode shows what it looks like to live that identity in practical relationships, parenting, marriage, loss, injustice, and suffering. Using vivid illustrations, Dr. Sandoval demonstrates how having God as our only source frees us from manipulation, fear, control, and taking life personally. He contrasts stewardship with ownership, revealing why loss only devastates when we believe something belonged to us. The message also reframes suffering as a “talent” God uses to extend comfort and redemption to others. By grounding identity in God’s character and love, this presentation offers a pathway to contentment, resilience, and unselfish love that remains steady regardless of circumstances.

programme.title: Awesome Science
programme.desc: Noah explores The Mammoth Site in Hot Springs, South Dakota. He’ll explore this amazing site, where over one hundred mammoths have been preserved in the sediments in an ancient sinkhole. He’ll find out how genetics can explain where the mammoths came from after the global Flood, why radio carbon dating can only give us accurate dates of a few thousand years, and how they could have reproduced so quickly after coming off the ark. Finally, he’ll explore how the Ice Age, caused by the global Flood, would have come and gone quickly, causing the right conditions to force the mammoths into extinction.

programme.desc: Gerente general de 3ABN Latino, John Dinzey, presenta entrevistas grabadas durante el 62.º Congreso de la IASD, celebrado en St. Louis, Missouri del 2025. Al Powell, quien aborda el tema de la importancia de los jóvenes y sus funciones en la iglesia. programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: Cómo pueden las familias enfrentar el estrés de la incertidumbre
programme.desc: En este episodio especial de 3ABN HOY EVH, John e Idalia Dinzey entrevistan a Carolann y el Dr. César De León abordan un tema crucial para nuestros tiempos: cómo las familias pueden enfrentar el estrés generado por la incertidumbre. Se analizan qué son el estrés y la ansiedad, cómo reacciona el cuerpo y la mente ante ellos, los efectos del estrés crónico en la familia, y se comparten estrategias prá cticas para afrontarlo juntos desde una perspectiva cristiana. Carolann y César De León han recorrido una jornada matrimonial marcada por los desafíos comunes de dos pecadores que aman y sirven a Dios. El Dr. César, pastor adventista ordenado y Terapeuta de Matrimonios y Familias con licencia, aporta su amplia experiencia pastoral y clínica al diálogo. Encuentre más programas sobre salud emocional, relaciones y vida espiritual en la programación de 3ABN Latino. In addition to the career opportunities, the show welcomes career counselors and HR specialists who provide tips to help the military members ease back into the civilian workforce. The show also features organizations that provide services to help facilitate the transition process. Gigi Stone Woods hosts the half-hour show.

programme.title: Small Town Big Deal
programme.desc: To put a spin on a popular saying about Las Vegas, what happens in a small town stays in a small town. That's because small cities and towns across America often get lost in the mainstream media that focuses on major metropolitan areas like New York and Los Angeles. "Small Town Big Deal" tries to change that by telling the stories of innovation, tradition and success that are happening in rural places. Episodes cover small-town residents having an impact on others through their actions and notable businesses, including the Frankenmuth, Mich., retail store that is considered the world's largest Christmas store.

programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

But when she dutifully accepts the task of helping Gwen and her estranged husband Eddie (John Cusack) make it through one last public appearance masterminded by legendary press agent Lee Phillips (Billy Crystal), forever devoted Kiki finds that her job is about to get even harder when her and Eddie's relationship takes a romantic turn.

programme.title: The Lazarus Project
programme.desc: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

programme.title: Runaway
programme.desc: Two police officers (Tom Selleck, Cynthia Rhodes) of the future hunt a bad batch of robots programmed to kill by a madman (Gene Simmons).","large":"In this advanced society, most homes have robots that perform everyday menial duties. Every so often, one malfunctions, and Sgt. Jack Ramsay (Tom Selleck), an expert in rogue machines, must deal with it. When he and his new partner, Karen Thompson (Cynthia Rhodes), investigate a robot-involved homicide, they discover strange computer chips. Rather than a malfunction, someone is programming the robots to kill. The police must find whoever is behind the murder before more harm is done.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.","large":"On the planet of Krull, an evil creature called the Beast decimates the world's army and kidnaps the lovely Princess Lyssa, who is destined to become queen. Her brave beau, Prince Colwyn, leads a motley band of warriors, including Ergo and Kegan, to rescue his beloved. However, before he can face the Beast, Colwyn must locate a mystical weapon known as the Glaive, which he can use to slay the hideous villain.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: Two lazy primitives (Jack Black, Michael Cera) begin an epic journey through the ancient world after they are banished from their village.","large":"After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: A young man (Penn Badgley) becomes increasingly suspicious that his mother's new lover (Dylan Walsh) is concealing an evil side.","large":"When Michael Harding (Penn Badgley) returns home from military school, he discovers that his mother (Sela Ward) has a new man, named David (Dylan Walsh), in her life. Though David makes Michael's mother very happy, Michael cannot seem to shake feelings of distrust. He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side.

programme.title: The Art of War
programme.desc: Underground after being accused of murdering a Chinese ambassador, a security expert (Wesley Snipes) comes out of hiding when terrorists threaten the United Nations.","large":"He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life.

programme.title: The Replacement Killers
programme.desc: An Asian crime czar pursues a forger (Mira Sorvino) and a hired gun (Chow Yun-Fat) who failed to kill a policeman's (Michael Rooker) boy.","large":"Hired assassin John Lee (Chow Yun-Fat) is asked by Chinatown crime boss Terence Wei (Kenneth Tsang) to murder the young son of policeman Stan Zedkov (Michael Rooker). Lee has the boy in his sights, but his conscience gets the better of him, and he spares the child's life. Afraid that Wei will take revenge on his family in China, Lee seeks out expert forger Meg Coburn (Mira Sorvino) to obtain the passport he needs to get out of the country, but a band of replacement killers is soon on his trail.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Nuclear testing in the South Pacific produces a giant mutated lizard that wreaks havoc upon New York City.","large":"During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
programme.desc: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.","large":"The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone.

programme.title: Lakeview Terrace
programme.desc: A police officer, the self-proclaimed watchdog of his neighborhood, becomes increasingly hostile toward the interracial couple next door.","large":"An uptight cop (Samuel L. Jackson), the self-appointed watchdog of his neighborhood, strongly disapproves of the interracial newlyweds (Patrick Wilson, Kerry Washington) who just moved in next door. He becomes increasingly hostile toward the innocent pair, going to great lengths to force them out of their home. The situation changes when the young couple decide to fight back.

programme.title: Talhotblond
programme.desc: Thomas meets a beautiful teenager online, with whom he engages in a nearly two-year romance over the Internet until she learns the truth about him, which leads Thomas to exact the ultimate revenge.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Laura's family dies in a fire while living in Spain, and as she prepares to move back to the United States, she learns their deaths were not accidental. She goes undercover to find out the truth and becomes embroiled in mob crimes.

programme.title: Facing the Giants
programme.desc: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.","large":"Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

programme.title: U-Turn
programme.desc: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.","large":"In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: Jury Duty
programme.desc: A goof-off juror (Pauly Shore) stalls a trial to take advantage of his lifestyle being paid for by the court.","large":"An unemployed male stripper and certifiable slacker, Tommy Collins (Pauly Shore) ends up homeless when his mom throws him out of their trailer. Desperate for a place to stay, Collins figures that landing a spot on a jury should get him a roof over his head, food in his belly and a few bucks in his pocket. Shockingly, his plan works -- and he will do anything to delay the trial's verdict so he can keep living large and make his moves on knockout juror Monica (Tia Carrere).

programme.title: Cops and Robbersons
programme.desc: Police partners move in with a would-be policeman (Chevy Chase) and his family to monitor a criminal next door.","large":"Tough-guy police officer Jake Stone and his less seasoned partner, Tony Moore, are intent on taking down Osborn, a ruthless criminal. However, since Osborn is holed up in the suburbs, Jake and Tony must hold their stakeout in a neighboring house, home to the Robbersons. The well-meaning family, including patriarch Norman, tries to assist the cops in their duties, but it proves to be unwanted help.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: Two lazy primitives (Jack Black, Michael Cera) begin an epic journey through the ancient world after they are banished from their village.","large":"After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur.

programme.title: Fun With Dick and Jane
programme.desc: After losing their jobs, an affluent couple (Jim Carrey, Téa Leoni) turn to robbery to support their lifestyle.","large":"After Dick Harper (Jim Carrey) loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane (Téa Leoni), turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister (Alec Baldwin) actually swindled the company, they plot revenge.

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: A publicist (Billy Crystal) tries to convince the press that the feuding co-stars of a new movie are still in love.","large":"For an awkward, self-conscious girl like Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to a beautiful megastar like Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) isn't easy. But when she dutifully accepts the task of helping Gwen and her estranged husband Eddie (John Cusack) make it through one last public appearance masterminded by legendary press agent Lee Phillips (Billy Crystal), forever devoted Kiki finds that her job is about to get even harder when her and Eddie's relationship takes a romantic turn.

programme.title: Mary Reilly
programme.desc: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (John Malkovich) confides in a young chambermaid (Julia Roberts) and transforms into evil Mr. Hyde in 19th-century London.","large":"A maid at the household of noted physician Dr. Henry Jekyll (John Malkovich), Mary Reilly (Julia Roberts) admires her employer, who also seems intrigued by her. Eventually, Mary meets Jekyll's mysterious and charismatic associate, Edward Hyde (also Malkovich), and she also seems to have an attraction to him. As Mary spends time with both men, she starts to suspect there is a strange connection between the two of them, and this revelation places her life in danger.

programme.title: Crooked House
programme.desc: Adapted by Julian Fellowes, Tim Rose Price and Gilles Paquet-Brenner.

programme.title: Persuasion
programme.desc: When Frederick Wentworth -- the one who got away -- crashes back into Anne Elliot's life, she must choose between putting the past behind her or listening to her heart when it comes to second chances.

programme.title: I Dreamed of Africa
programme.desc: After a harrowing car accident, a woman (Kim Basinger) and her family (Vincent Perez, Liam Aiken) move to Africa where she eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.","large":"Inspired by the true story of indomitable Kuki Gallmann, the film tells of a beautiful and inquisitive woman who had the courage to escape from her comfortable yet monotonous life in Italy to start anew in the African wilderness with her son, Emanuele, and her new husband, Paolo. Gallmann faces great danger there but eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.

programme.title: Nothing in Common
programme.desc: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.","large":"A successful advertising executive, David Basner, is working on a project that could make him partner at his company. When his parents suddenly end their 36-year marriage, he is thrown into the role of caregiver, dealing with his delicate mother, Lorraine, and his combative father, Max, who provides constant aggravation and bitter remarks. When one of his parents gets sick, David must choose what is more important, his family or his career.

programme.title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
programme.desc: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

programme.title: Red Water
programme.desc: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.","large":"Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.","large":"The prosperous town of Antonio Bay, Ore., is born in blood, as the town's founders get their money by murdering a colony of lepers. But the truth of what they did is concealed from subsequent generations. More than 100 years later, Elizabeth Williams (Maggie Grace), whose family lives in Antonio Bay, returns just as a statue in tribute to the founders is to be unveiled. When a mysterious fog rolls in, Elizabeth and her boyfriend (Tom Welling) soon discover it has vengeful supernatural powers.

programme.title: Darkness Falls
programme.desc: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.","large":"In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda.

programme.title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
programme.desc: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose

programme.title: Craig's Wife
programme.desc: A pushy pessimist with an eye for the finer things in life, Harriet (Rosalind Russell) has married Walter Craig (John Boles) because he is able to provide the kind of posh lifestyle she is certain she deserves. She feels not the slightest bit of guilt about her lack of affection for her husband, and aside from John himself, everyone around her seems to realize this. But when her husband gets a scare involving the police, Harriet's way of life is threatened.

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: A Woman of Distinction
programme.desc: Reserved college dean Susan Middlecott (Rosalind Russell) is all business and can't be bothered with love. However, when Susan meets charming British astronomy professor Alec Stevenson (Ray Milland), it seems that romance could be in the air. Though she resists being paired with Alec, things don't go as planned -- particularly when a publicity agent and even Susan's amiable father (Edmund Gwenn) get involved. Soon Susan may just be in love, whether she likes it or not.

programme.title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
programme.desc: David Sloane (Dean Martin) suspects that his married friend, Harry (Eli Wallach), may be fooling around on his wife, so he intends to steal his mistress away from him. David assumes Harry is going after his secretary, Carol (Stella Stevens), and he quickly charms her into a relationship. Problem solved, David thinks, until he discovers that he assumed wrong and that Harry has actually been having an affair with his beautiful neighbor, Muriel (Anne Jackson).

programme.title: Our Wife
programme.desc: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

programme.title: To Sir, With Love
programme.desc: American Mark Thackeray (Sidney Poitier) recently received his degree in engineering, but cannot find work. To make ends meet, he takes a job as a teacher in a rough London East End school populated mostly with troublemakers who were rejected from other schools for their behavior. While the students at first see Thackeray as just another teacher open for ridicule and bullying, his calm demeanor and desire to see them succeed gradually earn him their respect.

Bored and no closer to fixing their problems through counseling, the couple opts to divorce, and the proceeding tug-of-war over children, money and possessions reveals that maintaining their marriage was far easier than ending it. Along the way are attempts for both at new relationships, with the subject of alimony playing a hidden role in matters.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: A police officer seems to have committed suicide, but Detective Dave Bannion thinks there's more to the story. After talking to the man's mob-connected mistress, Bannion discovers far-reaching corruption that leads all the way from the police station to kingpin Mike Lagana. But when the policeman's lover is killed, it becomes clear that crossing Lagana is a dangerous thing to do. Soon Bannion finds himself marked for death and his family in mortal danger.

He declares his love, and, although Helen insists that her career will always come first, the two get married. Soon, Peter is consumed by jealous suspicions of his wife's male patients and embarrasses Helen several times. Fearful of driving her away, Peter launches into character-changing behavior to prove his love.

programme.title: Three on a Couch
programme.desc: Christopher Pride (Jerry Lewis) has been offered an important commission in Paris but can't convince his girlfriend, Dr. Elizabeth Acord (Janet Leigh), to take some time off from her psychiatric practice. Elizabeth is worried about three of her female patients, all of whom are extremely hostile toward men and very needy. Christopher, anxious to leave for France, decides to impersonate the ideal man for each of Elizabeth's patients, in hopes of lessening their dependency on her.

programme.title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
programme.desc: Ellen Grant (Lucille Ball) is the worst student at her secretarial school, yet surprisingly, she is hired by real estate agent Dick Richmond (William Holden). It turns out that Dick's real estate office is just a front for a betting operation. When Ellen unknowingly takes a large bet from Dick's old flame, Peggy (Janis Carter), Peggy demands that Dick must either pay up or run off with her. It's up to the dizzy Miss Grant to find a way to extract Dick from this mess.

programme.title: Born Free
programme.desc: At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. After the two larger lions are shipped off to a zoo in the Netherlands, the smallest of the three, Elsa, stays with the couple. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo.

programme.title: Jesus for Asia Faith Camp
programme.sub-title: Two Types of Sending - Ramon & Shandy Tengkano
programme.desc: With every missionary stepping into the mission field, stories and miracles are bound to happen! Join us in this inspiring series as missionaries working with Jesus For Asia share those amazing stories and miracles! Whether you're looking for inspiration, a boost of faith, or simply a good story, this series will leave you moved and motivated.

programme.title: Come Out of Her My People
programme.desc: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

programme.title: Cracking The Genesis Code
programme.desc: On the surface the book of Genesis appears to be a mere collection of ancient stories. But don't be fooled! Beneath the external simplicity lies a secret code which, when broken, reveals in no uncertain terms what will happen in the future. This series reveals the intimate connection between the first book of the Bible, Genesis, and the last book, Revelation. Don't miss this life changing experience!

programme.title: Who's Rockin The House
programme.desc: You may be surprised to learn that Satan once served as the choir director in Heaven. Since his fall, he has used his musical gifts as a powerful tool to influence and corrupt humanity. Tragically, even followers of Christ have begun to blend the sacred with the profane. As the end approaches, don’t be deceived by the counterfeit, emotionally charged worship experiences that Satan is orchestrating to lead many astray before the close of probation and the return of Christ. By studying Biblical principles, you can gain the spiritual discernment needed to distinguish between worship that is truly pleasing to God—both in personal and corporate worship—and that which is not.

programme.title: Sabbath School Like
programme.sub-title: Lessons of Faith from Joshua: The Conflict Behind All Conflicts

programme.title: The 24 Elders
programme.sub-title: The Return of the War Hero
programme.desc: There has been much discussion in the Seventh-day Adventist church about the identity of the 24 elders. Some believe that they represent those who resurrected with Jesus. Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

programme.title: Your Health Matters - Magna Parks
programme.desc: In this series Psychologist Dr. Magna Porterfield along side health and wellness coach Ron Porterfield, share their passions and insights regarding a holistic healing that connects mental and physical health.

programme.title: The Real Gospel In 10
programme.sub-title: Who Is Jesus Christ and How Did He Live? Part 1
programme.desc: In this busy world it can feel difficult finding time for long hours of study on any given subject. But it's important we do not neglect our study of the Bible; the true foundation for our lives. This series will help condense the basic topics of the gospel into easy 10 minute segments.

programme.title: Adverum Productions - Journeys
programme.desc: In his younger years, Christopher’s life mantra was ‘work hard, play hard’. Follow his 180º turnaround from a hedonistic lifestyle to an active faith – with some detours along the way.

programme.title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2
programme.sub-title: What to Do When Trust Is Broken
programme.desc: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. Join us in this transformative journey to enrich your life and your relationships, one episode at a time.

programme.title: Impact Hope
programme.desc: President Hans Thygeson and co-founder Mindy Thygeson worked together to implement Impact Hope, a sponsorship program that sends refugee students to safer Christian boarding schools throughout Rwanda. At these Christian boarding schools the refugees enjoy better living conditions, quality education, and an opportunity to learn more about God and His loving plan for them. Through this opportunity they can graduate with career eligibility and move their families out of the refugee camps for good!

programme.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
programme.desc: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

programme.title: Anchor 2023: The Great Prophecieis of the Old Testament
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually so that they cannot be moved and to provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them.

programme.title: It Is Written - with John Bradshaw
programme.desc: It Is Written is the flagship program of the It Is Written ministry, which for more than six decades has shared the transforming teachings of the Bible directly from the pages of God’s Word. Presented by Pastor John Bradshaw and often filmed in fascinating and visually stunning locations around the world, It Is Written covers a wide range of Biblical subjects and shares faith in Jesus Christ as the hope of the world.

programme.title: Being Woman
programme.desc: Being Woman is an empowering educational series that delves into the intricacies of women's health. Whether tackling menstrual irregularities, fertility concerns, hormone imbalance, or just wanting to understand the female anatomy, this series gives viewers a deeper understanding of the body, mind and spirit connection. We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

programme.title: Summit 2024: The Faith Once Delivered to the Saints
programme.desc: The Secrets Unsealed Summit is an anual spiritually-enriching experience where Pastor Bohr and guest speakers address cutting-edge subjects through practical bible studies. Watch and be blessed!

programme.title: The Prophetic Panorama
programme.desc: It seems today there are as many interpretations of Bible prophecy as there are interpreters. Is there an ironclad method for interpreting Bible prophecy? Are televangelists trustworthy in what they teach about Israel, the seventy weeks, the rapture of the church, the tribulation and the Antichrist or are they setting us up for Satan's final deception? Don't miss the answers to these and other questions in this enlightening series.

programme.title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
programme.sub-title: The Dead Who Stand Before God
programme.desc: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

programme.title: I'd Like to Know
programme.desc: Secrets Unsealed weekly Question and Answer program that dives into the Scriptures to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your submitted questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom that align with the teachings of the Adventist Church. Send us YOUR questions at tv@sumtv. org and your question may be featured in an upcoming episode!

programme.title: Amazing Facts with Doug Bachelor
programme.sub-title: The Woman in the Wilderness Part 2/2

programme.title: Timeless Healing Insights from the Gospel of Mark
programme.desc: We continue to look at Jesus, the Master Teacher, who often taught using parables and their healing powers.

programme.title: Sabbath School Like
programme.sub-title: Lessons of Faith from Joshua: The Conflict Behind All Conflicts

programme.title: Fake News
programme.sub-title: Lying Media and the Dishonest Press
programme.desc: Who can we trust today? It seems as if Fake News is all around us! Can Fake News even penetrate our Advent circles? If so, how?

programme.title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

programme.title: The Great Cosmic Controversy
programme.sub-title: How God Clears His Name from False Charges
programme.desc: Seventh-day Adventists often refer to the “doctrine” of the sanctuary. But the sanctuary is much more than a mere doctrine of the church. It is actually the World View that unites all the Bible doctrines into a beautiful mosaic of truth. In this series Pastor Bohr links the sanctuary with the overarching concept of the great conflict between good and evil and explains how Jesus, step by step, resolves the universal problem of evil. If you want to know how evil began, why it continues and how it will end this is the series for you.

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

programme.title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2
programme.sub-title: What If I Like Someone Who Doesn't Like Me Back?
programme.desc: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. Join us in this transformative journey to enrich your life and your relationships, one episode at a time.

programme.title: Reversing Autoimmune
programme.desc: What are autoimmune diseases? Can they actually be reversed? At just 29 years old, Gabriel started seeing the first signs of the same autoimmune disease that killed his mother and grandmother, autoimmune liver cirrhosis. He suffered through chronic fatigue, migraine headaches, food allergies, problems sleeping, and a terrible skin fungus that covered a third of his body. However, what began as a death sentence turned into a wonderful blessing of health and discovery. With the blessing of God, through much prayer, years of research and trial and error, Gabriel Arruda successfully reversed his autoimmune disease without modern medicine. In this series, you are going to learn how diet, environmental toxins,and genes effect autoimmune diseases and what you can do about it.

programme.title: Jesus Is Coming
programme.sub-title: The Second Coming of Jesus - Melvin Blue
programme.desc: In a world full of chaos, war, and deception, God’s Word gives us clear signs that Jesus is coming soon. This series will unveil essential truths from the Bible to prepare you and your loved ones for the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Liberty of Conscience Threatened
programme.desc: Secrets Unsealed partner with Keep the Faith ministry for a discussion on the developments of Bible prophecy that we see unfolding in current events.

programme.title: Silencing Satan
programme.desc: Humanity has witnessed Satan’s relentless attempts to bring about destruction. In the face of such pervasive evil, sincere questions naturally arise - questions that may cause people to doubt God’s power, love, or even His very existence. programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: A psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) finally believes a patient (Bruce Willis) who claims to be a time-traveler sent to 1996 to prevent a virulent holocaust.","large":"Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: A man (Michael Gross) hires a mercenary to destroy gigantic worms that are terrorizing a mining town in the 1800s.","large":"Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: Crew members (Nathan Fillion, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk) aboard a transport vessel get caught in a deadly conflict in the wake of a galactic war.","large":"In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: Passengers marooned on a remote planet soon learn that their only hope from the deadly creatures lurking in the dark is a dangerous escaped convict. Starring Vin Diesel and Radha Mitchell.","large":"When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.","large":"In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.","large":"Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: To avenge his father's death, a young man (Michael Copon) embarks on a quest against a king (Randy Couture).","large":"After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: Hulk

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: An undercover officer (Arnold Schwarzenegger) teaches a rowdy class of peewees, to identify one whose mother must be found.","large":"In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: Thunderbirds

But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: A low-rent private detective poses as a preppy nerd in order to foil a plot by conspirators.

programme.title: Alpha Dog

programme.title: Chinese Zodiac
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

programme.title: Trespass

Fortunately, the treasure hunters have kidnapped a bargaining chip: King James' half-brother, Lucky (Devoreaux White). But this might not be enough to get them -- and their gold -- out of the building intact.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.","large":"Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Friendly ghosts help a psychic detective (Michael J. Fox) probe the hauntings that killed residents of a coastal California town.","large":"Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Noni and Kaz feel an instant attraction, but those in their orbit oppose the romance for fear the pair will stray from the course planned out for both of them.

programme.title: Indipendente Mente
programme.desc: La moda del gas esilarante. Boom tra giovanissimi della droga della risata. In esclusiva la storia di una mamma che lotta contro la dipendenza del figlio. L'intervista al ministro dell'Istruzione Valditara. Rischio di asfissia, risate senza controllo, senso di onnipotenza e alterazione psicofisica. Sono questi gli effetti di una nuova droga in voga tra i giovanissimi e di cui però c'è ancora scarsa consapevolezza. È la droga del palloncino.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Meine Katze aus Damaskus - Wie Geflüchtete ihre Haustiere wiedersehen
programme.desc: Mehr als eine Million Menschen sind auf der Flucht vor dem Bürgerkrieg in Syrien in Europa untergekommen. Viele haben auch ihr Haustier zurückgelassen. Eine geflüchtete Syrerin hilft ihren Landsleuten bei der Wiedervereinigung mit ihren Vierbeinern.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal ist Cody Buffinton gemeinsam mit Lexi Limitless in New Orleans unterwegs. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden zunächst ein verlassenes Spital in der Stadt in Louisiana. Anschließend trifft Cody noch auf Brutus, einen Riesenalligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh ist in der ehemaligen Sowjetrepublik Armenien unterwegs und besucht die Hauptstadt Jerewan. Er hat vor, dort einige der längst verlassenen, aber noch immer faszinierenden Gebäude aus der Zeit der Sowjetbesatzung zu besuchen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura kehrt nach Gary im Nordwesten des Bundesstaates Indiana zurück, um sich zu Hause einmal genauer umzusehen. Er und seine Freunde erkunden gemeinsam ein ehemaliges Bankgebäude, das Auditorium und den Bahnhof Union Train Station.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt ein Oldie-VW-Bus aus Arizona eine Frischzellenkur, während bei Lundtauto in Berlin ein Porsche 911 aus den 1970er-Jahren auf eine Komplettrestaurierung wartet. In Hamburg kommen nur britische Originale auf die Hebebühne.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Schrauber der Minis Hamburg lassen die Flex kreisen, um Rost von Minis zu entfernen. Porsche-Spezialist Thomas Lundt hat sich der anspruchsvollen Restaurierung von Oldtimern verschrieben, während in Hamburg eine Vespa aufgebaut wird.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt der T1-Oldie neue Safari-Fenster, während bei den Roller-Profis der Flying Classics heute eine Ausfahrt ansteht. Motor-Spezialist Michi von den Minis Hamburg setzt bei der Getriebereparatur nicht nur auf seine Erfahrung.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die frisch lackierte Porsche-Karosse wartet bei Lundt in Berlin auf das Motorfinish, während Manni von den Minis Hamburg eine durchgerostete Tür wieder auf Vordermann bringt. In der Roller-Werkstatt der Flying Classics ist Abschied angesagt.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Als innere Planeten bezeichnet man die vier Gesteinsplaneten Merkur, Venus, Erde und Mars. Sie zeichnen sich durch eine feste, felsige Oberfläche, eine hohe Dichte, geringere Größe und ihre Position innerhalb des Asteroidengürtels aus.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Die Raumsonden Voyager 1 und 2 erkunden seit 1977 die äußeren Planeten unseres Sonnensystems. Begleiten Sie spannende Missionen ins All und erfahren Sie, welche neuen Erkenntnisse spätere Flugkörper über diese Welten gewinnen konnten.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit dem Spitzer-Weltraumteleskop. Es macht eine bahnbrechende Entdeckung von Exoplaneten, die der Erde ähnlich sein könnten. Damit könnte die NASA neue Rückschlüsse über das Leben im Universum liefern.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Destination Pluto
programme.desc: Die NASA-Mission "New Horizons" untersucht in der Dokumentation die neuesten Erkenntnisse und Bilder vom Planeten Pluto. Der Pluto ist einer der kleinsten Planeten in unserem Sonnensystem und wird von fünf Monden umkreist.

programme.title: Die Geburt des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Das Sonnensystem ist nach dem Urknall aus dem Chaos entstanden. Die Planeten haben sich um die Sonne gebildet, einige sind in sie hinein gestürzt, andere sind für immer ins All geschleudert worden. So begann ein Kampf ums Überleben im Weltraum.

programme.title: Aurora - Fackeln am Firmament
programme.desc: Das geisterhafte Flackern der Polarlichter zieht die Menschen schon seit Urzeiten in den Bann. Der Film erzählt die wissenschaftlichen Zusammenhänge und die traditionellen Legenden der Naturvölker rund um die faszinierende Himmelserscheinung.

programme.title: Phänomen Sonnenfinsternis
programme.desc: In der Dokumentation wird über zwei Sonnenfinsternisereignisse im Jahr 2017 berichtet.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Die Crew entdeckt in der Ferne einen einsamen Wolf und nimmt seine Fährte auf. Dabei stoßen sie auf eine altbekannte Bärenfamilie. Durch sie gelangen sie an einen beliebten Ort zum Fischen, wo es vor hungrigen Bären nur so wimmelt.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: In der Nacht findet Casey ein verlassenes Bärenjunges. Am nächsten Tag beginnt er die Suche nach der Familie des kleinen Bären in der Hoffnung, sie wiederzuvereinigen. Auf dem Weg findet er Riedgras, was eine tolle Nahrungsquelle für Bären ist.

programme.title: Tracker Diaries - Die Bären von Alaska
programme.desc: Casey und seine Crew wandern durch den Katmai-Nationalpark. Dort entdecken sie die Knochen eines Buckelwals, der an Land gespült wurde. Doch die Wettervorhersage sieht schlecht aus, weshalb sie ihr Abenteuer womöglich vorzeitig abbrechen müssen.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt den sibirischen Tiger in seinem Lebensraum im Fernen Osten vor. Er ist die größte aller lebenden Katzen, doch im vergangenen Jahrhundert kam es zu einem fast vollständigen Zusammenbruch seiner Art.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt den Schneeleoparden in seinem Lebensraum im Fernen Osten vor. Das Überleben des Einzelgängers, der sogar im Hochgebirge existieren kann, ist durch Wilderei und Aussterben von Beutetieren stark gefährdet.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation behandelt das Leben der Pumas, einer Raubkatze in Nord-, Mittel- und Südamerika. Die mit bis zu zwei Metern Länge größte der Kleinkatzen ist in der Prärie ebenso anzutreffen wie im Dschungel oder auf den Bäumen.

programme.title: Das geheime Leben der Raubkatzen
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation behandelt das Leben der Löwen als König der Savanne in Afrika. Die zusammen mit dem Tiger größte der Raubkatzen lebt im Rudel mit einem Männchen als Alphatier. Das Alphatier muss sich der Konkurrenz der jüngeren Männchen erwehren.

programme.title: Einsame Atolle - Unbekannte Tiefen
programme.desc: Eine sechswöchige Expeditionsreise mit Wissenschaftlern aus aller Welt führt zu den Riffen des Aldabra-Atolls und dem wohl entlegensten Ort im Indischen Ozean: den versunkenen Inseln von Saya de Malha mit ihren einmaligen Seegraswiesen.

programme.title: Die große Algen-Invasion
programme.desc: Gigantische Algenteppiche breiten sich unaufhaltsam an den Küsten aus und bedrohen maritime Ökosysteme sowie den lokalen Tourismus. Forscher und Anwohner kämpfen gemeinsam gegen die grüne Flut, um das Gleichgewicht im Meer rasch wiederherzustellen.

programme.title: Reefs of Hope - Die Korallenretter
programme.desc: Weltweit beobachten Wissenschaftler, wie Korallenriffe durch die Erderwärmung stark bedroht sind. Die Wissenschaft versucht deshalb mit neuen Technologien das Absterben zu stoppen und eine Regeneration der Korallenriffe einzuleiten.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: James und sein älterer Bruder Colton fahren nach Austin, Texas, um BBQ von einem blinden Grillmeister und Live-Musik von einem blinden Musiker zu genießen. Ein kurzer Roadtrip nach Houston bringt sie mit der blinden Starköchin Christine Ha zusammen.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Die Reisereportage begleitet blinde Menschen auf ihren Abenteuern. In der siebten Folge der ersten Staffel werden die Sinne der Protagonisten an ungewöhnlichen Orten gefordert, während sie kulturelle sowie landschaftliche Highlights erleben.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der blinde Regisseur James Rath bereist Metropolen, um zu zeigen, dass dies auch für eingeschränkte Personen möglich ist - wenn es mit der Barrierefreiheit ernst genommen wird. Er und Cassie besuchen diesmal die "ETH Zürich".

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: In Tokio versucht James, sich nicht in der Menge zu verlieren. Er will zudem seine Angst vor Meeresfrüchten überwinden. Er trifft einen blinden Breakdancer und erfährt, wie Sehende und Blinde sich auf die nächste Naturkatastrophe vorbereiten.

programme.title: Blindspots - Blind um die Welt
programme.desc: Der Hochgeschwindigkeitszug bringt James nach Osaka und seinem Ziel näher: dem Aufstieg auf den Fuji. Abseits großer Städte sucht James in den Tempeln von Kyoto nach Frieden. Heilige Traditionen bieten ihm eine neue Perspektive auf das Leben.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Antarktis: Der Gigant erwacht
programme.desc: Die Antarktis enthält 75 Prozent des weltweiten Süßwassers, doch ihre Eisschicht ist durch die Erwärmung der Ozeane und den Anstieg des Meeresspiegels bedroht. Ein weibliches Forschungsteam besucht die Antarktis für Untersuchungen.

programme.title: Kamera-Frauen in der Wildnis
programme.desc: Seit einigen Jahrzehnten erzählen auch immer mehr Filmemacherinnen Geschichten aus der Wildnis. Die Sendung zeigt, was das Besondere an der Verbindung von Frauen zur Natur ist und welche Visionen sie für die Zukunft haben.

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Nach der Coronapause arbeitet die Technikwerkstatt im Wunderland mit Hochdruck an einem Jahrmarkt. Die Fahrgeschäfte sind alle Marke Eigenbau. Spezielle Motoren, Kugellager und Metallgetriebe sollen den Dauerbetrieb in der Anlage möglich machen.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Nach über einem Jahr Bauzeit und fast 25.000 Arbeitsstunden ist die neue Kirmes endlich fertig. Rund 100.000 LEDs verwandeln den Mini-Jahrmarkt in ein einzigartiges Lichtermeer. Baukosten für die acht Quadratmeter große Spielwiese Marke Eigenbau: 750.000 Euro. Ein technisches Meisterwerk ist auch der neue Leitstand. Von hier aus wird der gesamte Verkehr im Wunderland gesteuert und überwacht.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Das Miniaturwunderland auf Expansionskurs. Mit einem Übergang zum gegenüberliegenden Hafenspeicher sollen 3.500 Quadratmeter Modellbaufläche erschlossen werden. Das Einsetzen der 25 Meter langen Brücke mit einem 750-Tonnen-Kran - ein Drahtseilakt! Auch im Bauabschnitt Monaco geht es voran. Die Tüftler vom Dienst wollen die Formel-1-Rennatmosphäre so realistisch wie möglich auf die Piste bringen.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Miniatur Wunderland XXL
programme.desc: Anspannung im Wunderland: Aus Argentinien kommen die ersten Modell-Elemente für die brandneue Attraktion in Hamburg an: Der Südamerika-Abschnitt wird durch die abwechslungsreiche Welt Patagonien erweitert. Für die Modellbauer eine schweißtreibende Arbeit. Die teils mehrere hundert Kilogramm schweren Landschaften müssen erst einmal auf die richtigen Positionen gestellt werden. Und der Zeitplan ist knapp: Bis zur Eröffnung sind es nur ein paar Wochen!

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Neue Bäume und tote Hirsche: Die Aufforstung der Highlands
programme.desc: Um die neu gepflanzten Bäume in den schottischen Highlands zu schützen, haben Klimaschützer rund 15.000 Hirsche geschossen. Bei den ortsansässigen Jägern regt sich Widerstand. Sie fürchten um ihre Traditionen und wichtige Einnahmequellen.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2012 eröffnete die Entdeckung der Genom-Editierung der Gentechnik scheinbar unendliche Möglichkeiten. Doch seither ist den Wissenschaftlern bewusst geworden, dass eine allmächtige Gen-Schere unbrauchbar ist, wenn man nirgendwo schneiden kann.

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft
programme.desc: Athena erforscht einige der Probleme, mit denen Wissenschaftler und Umweltschützer konfrontiert werden, die versuchen, die Beziehung zur Energie grundlegend zu ändern. Sie erfährt vieles über erneuerbare Energien, die die Welt verändern können.

programme.title: Suppressed Science - Geheimnisse der Wissenschaft
programme.desc: Im Laufe der Jahrhunderte sind wissenschaftliche Theorien entstanden, die in ihrem Umfang und Ehrgeiz religiösen Kosmologien ähneln. Doch die Frage ist, ob es die Wissenschaft ermöglicht, eine allgemeine Weltformel zu entwickeln.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Als innere Planeten bezeichnet man die vier Gesteinsplaneten Merkur, Venus, Erde und Mars. Sie zeichnen sich durch eine feste, felsige Oberfläche, eine hohe Dichte, geringere Größe und ihre Position innerhalb des Asteroidengürtels aus.

programme.title: Raumsonden - Eroberer des Sonnensystems
programme.desc: Die Raumsonden Voyager 1 und 2 erkunden seit 1977 die äußeren Planeten unseres Sonnensystems. Begleiten Sie spannende Missionen ins All und erfahren Sie, welche neuen Erkenntnisse spätere Flugkörper über diese Welten gewinnen konnten.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit dem Spitzer-Weltraumteleskop. Es macht eine bahnbrechende Entdeckung von Exoplaneten, die der Erde ähnlich sein könnten. Damit könnte die NASA neue Rückschlüsse über das Leben im Universum liefern.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Destination Pluto
programme.desc: Die NASA-Mission "New Horizons" untersucht in der Dokumentation die neuesten Erkenntnisse und Bilder vom Planeten Pluto. Der Pluto ist einer der kleinsten Planeten in unserem Sonnensystem und wird von fünf Monden umkreist.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Restaurierung des Porsche 911 ist abgeschlossen. Thomas Lundt übernimmt die erste Probefahrt. Leistungsstark und tiefergelegt präsentiert sich auch der top überholte T1 von Toms Garage. In Hamburg prüft Helge, ob eine Vespa straßentauglich ist.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Werkstatt-Chef Thomas Lundt hat einen alten Porsche angeschleppt. Den Flying Classics aus Hamburg haben es Kultmopeds angetan. Besonders beliebt ist die Ost-Marke Simson. In Toms Roadhouse wird eine antike Vorkriegs-Limousine begutachtet.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Toms Roadhouse soll ein 80 Jahre alter Ford ein paar mehr Pferdestärken bekommen, während die Porsche-Experten von 9elf einen äußerst seltenen Carrera 3.0 auf dem Weg zur Hauptuntersuchung betreuen, die hoffentlich erfolgreich sein wird.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Bei Il Motore dreht sich fast alles um Antriebsmaschinen. Minustemperaturen für die Rarität von 9elf: eine Eisstrahlung beim Carrera 3.0. In der Halle der Flying Classics wartet ein schick überholtes Kultmoped auf die Abholung.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Die Städteentdecker Josh und Cody besuchen Barentsburg, eine russische Polarstation und Bergarbeitersiedlung am Isfjord auf Spitzbergen. Sie bereisen einige der schönsten Städte der Welt und entdecken dabei viele spektakuläre Orte.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh begibt sich auf eine weitere Reise. Diesmal macht er sich von Tirana, der Hauptstadt des alten Sowjet-Satelliten Albanien, auf den Weg, um Bunker und ein verstecktes Krankenhaus zu besichtigen. Er taucht in einer Piratenhöhle.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody Buffinton erlebt ein weiteres spannendes Abenteuer, als er in Lüderitz, Namibia, unterwegs ist. Er begibt sich in Gebiete abseits der ausgetretenen Pfade, durchquert die Wüste und reist weiter in die Geisterstadt Pomona.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh und Lexi Limitless erkunden gemeinsam die überfüllten Straßen von Tokio, der bevölkerungsreichsten Metropole Japans. Die beiden besuchen ein völlig verrücktes Monster-Café und ein verlassenes Liebeshotel in der faszinierenden Stadt.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal führt die Reise nach Nikko in Japan. Die Stadt liegt etwa 140 Kilometer nördlich von Tokio. Dort trifft Cody auf Sherman Mak. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden einen verlassenen Onsen und einen Vergnügungspark, das Western Village.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Jedes Jahr treffen sich internationale Hardcore-BMW-Fans in Thüringen. Das Syndikat Asphaltfieber ist das weltweit größte Treffen für Jünger der sportlichen Marke aus München. Die Leidenschaft für schnittiges Design und Hinterradantrieb vereint sie.

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button
programme.desc: When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg worried that a quick thumbs up or down would discourage more meaningful online interaction but eventually his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated
programme.desc: The Cubicle was originally designed to set workers free; a futuristic designer named Robert Propst dreamed up the cubicle as a groovy 1960s workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker's vast untapped potential.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy
programme.desc: Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China, and it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It
programme.desc: Florida wasn't always the Sunshine State; in the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a ritzy vacation destination, sparking a land boom the likes of which America had never seen before.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World
programme.desc: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue; Mauve takes over the fashion industry, make food look more appetizing, and enable stunning advances in medicine.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food
programme.desc: In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; the vanilla bean takes the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and forever changing how we eat.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: The Hollywood Actress That Laid the Groundwork for WiFi
programme.desc: During WWII, Actress Hedy Lamarr, deemed the world's most beautiful woman, invented a technology that laid the groundwork for the wireless internet of today.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment
programme.sub-title: Streaming: The Invention That Revolutionized Streaming Video
programme.desc: The early days of online video were plagued by low resolution, stamp-sized video, and unbearable buffering times but that changed when a breakthrough technology revolutionized streaming video and set the foundation for the era of Netflix.

programme.title: Becoming Martian
programme.desc: Evolutionary biologist Dr. Scott Solomon foresees a series of changes to our species from the size of our hearts and heads to the pigments in our skin.

programme.title: Space Phenomena
programme.desc: NASA's next-generation space telescope TESS (Exoplanet Survey Satellite) searches for Earth-like planets belonging to other star systems.

programme.title: Space Phenomena
programme.desc: The latest discoveries are drawing a link between black holes and the existence of life.

programme.title: Our Violent Sun
programme.desc: Our Sun could erupt at any moment, spewing a vast wave of charged particles toward Earth that could leave millions of people without power for up to a year.

programme.title: Amazing Gravity
programme.desc: Professor Jim Al-Khalili tries to find where gravity is weakest in Britain and where humans weigh the least.

programme.title: Amazing Gravity
programme.desc: Using Einstein's elaborate theories, Jim Al-Khalili looks at whether the rate humans age is affected by gravity and the speed at which the Earth moves.

programme.title: Becoming Martian

programme.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Girl Bombs
programme.desc: The scheming Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) is determined to conquer the world yet again, this time by deploying a legion of explosive robots that happen to look like gorgeous women. Fortunately for the citizens of the globe, suave secret agent Bill Dexter (Fabian) is out to foil Goldfoot's plans, which involve kidnapping a prominent American general (also Price) who bears a striking resemblance to Goldfoot. Also getting in on the antics is inept aspiring spy Franco (Franco Franchi).

programme.title: The Devil's Disciple
programme.desc: When Dick Dudgeon (Kirk Douglas) learns his father was executed by the British for treason at the onset of the Revolutionary War, he steals the body for a proper burial after minister Anthony Anderson's (Burt Lancaster) pleas for it are in vain. While visiting with the minister and his wife, the British mistakenly arrest Dick, who says nothing, choosing to stand in the minister's place. Can Anderson and the rebels convince Gen. Burgoyne (Laurence Olivier) to free Dick before he's hanged?

programme.title: The Happy Thieves
programme.desc: An art thief (Rex Harrison), his lover (Rita Hayworth) and a forger (Joseph Wiseman) plot to steal a Goya painting from the Prado museum in Madrid.

programme.title: Crime of Passion
programme.desc: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals.

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire.

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.
