programme.desc: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army.

programme.title: Ambush Bay
programme.desc: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day.

programme.title: The Secret Invasion
programme.desc: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise.

Rather than give in, the islanders hire soldier of fortune Rick Masters to help them smuggle the shipment off the island and sell it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell

Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: The Masque of the Red Death
programme.desc: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Cult of the Damned
programme.desc: An unscrupulous rock star brings decadence and debauchery to a naive young woman's wealthy household.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Paul (Peter Fonda), a director saddened by his failed marriage and unsatisfied with his work, is looking to start over. His friend, the cool, sage-like John (Bruce Dern), suggests that an LSD trip is exactly what Paul needs to get out of his rut. Paul decides to indulge, and experiences visions that are alternately beautiful and terrifying. His hallucinations, which include a carnival populated by dwarfs, bizarrely erotic encounters and even his own death, radically reshape his consciousness.

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH 2: Timmy to the Rescue
programme.desc: In this animated film, after recovering from an illness that plagued him in his youth, country mouse Timmy Brisby (Ralph Macchio) grows into a strong young rodent. And when fellow Thorn Valley resident Jenny McBride (Hynden Walsh) begs him to find her missing mother and father, he gets the opportunity to prove himself worthy of the Brisby name. Timmy sets out on a journey that puts him on a collision course with wicked mouse Martin (Eric Idle) and the dreaded National Institute of Mental Health.

programme.title: Sea Fury
programme.desc: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi).

programme.title: Operation Bikini
programme.desc: During World War II, a U.S. submarine under the command of Capt. Emmett Carey (Scott Brady) takes on the underwater demolition team of Lt. Morgan Hayes (Tab Hunter) -- which includes Seaman Joseph Malzone (Frankie Avalon) -- when the radar equipment of a sunken ship needs to be destroyed. Reaching their target at Bikini Atoll, they find the area full of hostile enemies and helpful guerrillas, including the stunning Reiko (Eva Six), with whom Hayes develops a relationship during the mission.

programme.title: Electra
programme.desc: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestis (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide?

programme.title: Eight on the Lam
programme.desc: A widower with seven children, Henry Dimsdale (Bob Hope) is employed as a bank teller. After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their baby sitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton).

programme.title: High Spirits
programme.desc: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: The Set Up
programme.desc: Charlie Thorpe is a brilliant security expert and convicted burglar. After being released from prison, Charlie resolves to turn his life around and takes a straight job designing the security for a newly renovated bank. However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank.

Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Hot Cars
programme.desc: A car salesman is framed for the murder of a police officer when he refuses to sell stolen vehicles for gangsters.

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

programme.title: Love Is a Ball
programme.desc: Matchmaker Etienne Pimm (Charles Boyer) makes his living by pairing European aristocrats with rich Americans, and his latest match is between Duke Gaspard Ducluzeau (Ricardo Montalban) and affluent heiress Millie Mehaffey (Hope Lange). Unfortunately, Ducluzeau, handsome and titled as he is, needs some help in acting aristocratic. Luckily, John Davis (Glenn Ford) is on hand to teach the Duke how to behave like the high-society man he is, at least until Davis and Mehaffey meet.

programme.title: What's New, Pussycat?
programme.desc: An irrepressible cad by nature, Michael James (Peter O'Toole) is determined to reform and stay faithful to his fiancée, Carole (Romy Schneider). However, Michael's attempt at fidelity is jeopardized when numerous attractive women become smitten with him, including Liz (Paula Prentiss) and Rita (Ursula Andress). Meanwhile, another of Michael's admirers, Renée (Capucine), is the object of fixation for his therapist, the wacky Dr. Fritz Fassbender (Peter Sellers).

programme.title: Lord Love a Duck
programme.desc: An unusually gifted high school senior, Alan Musgrave (Roddy McDowall), decides to direct his mental powers toward helping an innocent new student, Barbara Ann Greene (Tuesday Weld), achieve her goal of popularity. With Alan's guidance, Barbara climbs the social ladder, finds a husband and eventually gets a shot at a glamorous movie career. But when Barbara's husband begins to get in the way of her ambitions, Alan will stop at nothing to make sure she reaches the top.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.title: Dance With Me Henry
programme.desc: Children help an amusement-park owner (Lou Costello) and his buddy (Bud Abbott) get out of trouble with gangsters.

programme.title: Sinful Davey
programme.desc: Though his father received a death sentence for thievery, Davey Haggart (John Hurt) nevertheless wants to be a criminal too. He quits the military and starts carrying out small-time robberies. His pal Annie (Pamela Franklin) wants him to quit the criminal life, but she grudgingly helps him avoid law enforcement. Finally, though, Constable Richardson (Nigel Davenport) catches up with Davey, who will be hanged unless Annie and a fellow thief named MacNab (Ronald Fraser) can stop his execution.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
programme.desc: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

programme.title: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
programme.desc: Frustrated that he still hasn't lost his virginity, teenage grocery store delivery boy Jamie McGregor (Barry Evans) appeals to Spike (Christopher Timothy), an older ladies' man, for advice. After failing to seal the deal with several local girls because of his working class mannerisms and a paralyzing case of teenage self-doubt, Jamie struggles to get the attention of Mary Gloucester (Judy Geeson), a beautiful classmate who doesn't seem to know he even exists.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Return From the Ashes
programme.desc: An expert chess player, Stanislaus Pilgrim is also an unrepentant cad and schemer. Looking for a way to inherit a fortune, Stanislaus marries Dr. Michele Wolf, a rich Jewish widow. Later, however, he becomes involved with his wife's stepdaughter, Fabienne, resulting in a complicated web of seduction and deception that ends in murder. Will the duplicitous Stanislaus succeed in getting Michele's money?

programme.title: Greyfriars Bobby
programme.desc: When his owner, police officer John Gray (Thomas Lockyer), is killed in the line of duty, Bobby, a particularly faithful West Highland terrier, takes up residence in the graveyard where Gray was interred. Bobby charms everyone he meets, and the canine's continued exploits make him a legend among the local working poor. When oppressive factory owner Smithie (Sean Pertwee) plots to kill Bobby, Gray's impoverished young ward, Ewan (Oliver Golding), must protect him from a ruthless dog catcher.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.title: Allotment Wives
programme.desc: An Army officer investigates a bigamy racket in which scheming women marry soldiers to collect their government checks.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Jacqueline
programme.desc: A Belfast laborer (John Gregson) loses his job and drinks, but his daughter (Jacqueline Ryan) saves the day.

programme.title: I Want to Live!
programme.desc: This film tells the riveting true story of brazen bad girl Barbara Graham (Susan Hayward, in an Academy Award-winning performance), a perpetual offender who tries to go straight but is sent to death row after being implicated in a murder. When journalist Ed Montgomery (Simon Oakland), whose initial newspaper articles on Barbara's crime played up her recklessness, becomes convinced that she may be innocent, he begins a desperate campaign to save her from the gas chamber.

programme.title: An Infinite Tenderness
programme.desc: Two physically impaired children form a close connection to each other.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. programme.title: Penitentiary

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Mang
programme.desc: Aarti (Rekha), a homely but wealthy widow, is the unwitting target of a scheme to divest her of her family, fortune and life. Her father is killed by one of his workers. The worker's nephew Sanjay (Kabir Bedi) woos her and weds her, then tosses her into a crocodile-filled lake (aided by her best friend, her husband's secret lover) with the goal of inheriting his dead wife's riches. But though maimed, Aarti lives, has plastic surgery that transforms her into a beauty -- and plots her revenge.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.desc: EPS 11.

programme.title: 人蛇鼠 / Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來，接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結，圖取莊家產業，並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德！怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下，反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠，欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死，「西西」為救嬰兒，與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...

programme.title: 天龍八部 / The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功，卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中，段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下，段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤，得到了絕世功力，最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。.

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣錄 / Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次，大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所，但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助，為他解決疑難！.

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記 / Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛，當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後，再遇愛人阿花，可惜她已嫁為人妻；另一方面，戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...

programme.title: 瘋猴 / Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」，但卻被惡霸設計陷害，更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人，直到遇上街頭小子小侯，決將一身「猴拳」，傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手，勢要一雪前恥。.

programme.title: 雙星伴月 / The Happy Trio
programme.desc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓，生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星，從此飛黃騰達，但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西...

programme.title: 搏盡 / Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: 碼頭工人林四海，一次助中央特派專員鄭志成脫險，因而得以加入警局；後告發要員收規，獲局長賞識，升為副官；繼而林藉局長三姨太欠下巨額賭債，唆使局長允其代受賄替三姨太還債；林辭去職務在黑道大展拳腳，復與碼頭總管事梅寶聯盟…….

programme.title: 藍與黑 / The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間，少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦，不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...

programme.title: 鬼馬兩金剛 / Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天，他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢，途中卻遇上革命戰士，並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士？.

programme.title: 鱷魚河 / Crocodile River
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族，被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔，誰也不願築橋往來。然而，命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守，他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流，更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。.

programme.title: 方世玉與胡惠乾 / The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等，勾結清廷，甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人，方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花，胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺；胡一次尋仇不遂，為方所救，後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功...影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面，出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。.

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了 / Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面，雙方即發生誤會，大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時，又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...

programme.title: 追魂鏢 / Killer Darts
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活，非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒，玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛，但玉蟬偶遇胡，誤信劉是殺母仇人….

programme.title: 大軍閥 / The Warlord
programme.desc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁，老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來，當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現，槍殺了這個賣國賊。.

programme.title: 大軍閥 / The Warlord
programme.desc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁，老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來，當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現，槍殺了這個賣國賊。.

programme.title: 毒龍潭 / Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙，盜去師父的玉龍劍，並生下一子一女；後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭，唐抱子虞江逃走，女青兒則歸師公門下；二十年後，劍再次被盜，青女扮男裝，私下尋劍，卻遇樊舊友天涯客...

programme.title: 故都春夢 / Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》，內容描述民國初年，富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙，同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑，更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助，才從大帥手中救回愛人。.

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 武松 / Tiger Killer
programme.desc: 一次醉酒後，武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎，因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松，但遭他拒絕。後來，潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染，及後姦情敗露，兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後，先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶，為兄長報仇。.

programme.title: 卒仔抽車 / Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子，遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成，達成了一個賭局，要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力，終戰勝億萬富豪！.

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 神鵰俠侶 / Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: 郭靖與黃蓉將結拜兄弟楊康之子撫養成人，並取名楊過。黃蓉恐其學武後，替父報仇，為免養虎為患，不許楊過習武。負氣出走的楊過偶遇走火入魔的歐陽鋒，獲授蛤蟆功，更無意中獲悉自己的身世…….

programme.title: 夕陽戀人 / Sunset
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工，在夕陽萌生感情，後女因識破男的太子爺身份，深感受騙...

programme.title: 叉手 / Masked Avengers
programme.desc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織，專殺江湖豪俠，彼等行事，均帶面具，故彼等究為何人，無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等，赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在，擬一舉殲滅該組織，為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭，態度極為神秘，暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...

programme.title: 玉堂春 / The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛，無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾，卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫，判以死罪。已考取功名的王，決意開堂覆審救蘇...

programme.title: 武館 / Martial Club
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛，得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄，從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品，更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。.

programme.title: 雙鐲 / The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權，甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人，之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子，於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。.

programme.title: 血鸚鵡 / Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡，看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相；與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜，葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡，鐵死於它的魔力之下；後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後，屍體卻離奇失蹤，葉經歷重重險阻後，終於見到真正的血鸚鵡….

programme.title: 血鸚鵡 / Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡，看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相；與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜，葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡，鐵死於它的魔力之下；後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後，屍體卻離奇失蹤，葉經歷重重險阻後，終於見到真正的血鸚鵡….

programme.title: 狂戀詩 / Summer Heat
programme.desc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟，一個放浪，一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪，情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫，得知此秘密，大偉以此威脅，迫珠迪和他幽會，自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關，手法細膩，而結局亦出人意表。.

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄 / The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位，令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客，最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位？.

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 踩綫 / Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導，為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述，呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒， 由越南逃至澳門；呂於香港出生，可在港居留，乃與李分散；鄭則仕飾呂之叔父，為一幹練警探，即介紹呂加入員警世界，派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害；而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...

programme.title: 千門八將 / Notorious Eight
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述，正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次，他在與“賭魔”的賭局中，被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後，賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇，正將被賭魔以千術擊敗，含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇，邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博......

programme.title: 青春1000日 / The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃，由當舞女之姊撫養成長，方則出身富家，受母呵護備至。畢業後，凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍，方則滿足於平淡生活中；但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生，改寫了他們三人的一生….

programme.title: 殺手三分半鐘 / The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後，悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮，新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標，不料，未等雷下手，另一殺手已捷足先登，倒在地上卻是另一要人，雷頓時成了替罪羊。.

programme.title: 憤怒青年 / The Delinquent
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉鬱，與父親缺乏溝通，被人利用，誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘，竟然出賣父親，讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加，獨闖飛仔巢，逐一將之擊斃，自已也進入瘋狂狀態。.

programme.title: 玉面俠 / The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: 章臻與月奴相愛卻不被接納，二人被四怪所殺後，留下一對雙胞兒。月奴的姊姊希望挽救其門派的聲望，拆散雙胞，將他們分別送到對立門派收養。十八年後，雙胞胎兒重聚，互相傷殘，亦隨即掀起江湖風風雨雨。.

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇記 / Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡，希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要，但卻碰上連串的奇遇，乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄，差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境？.

programme.title: 太陰指 / Finger of Doom
programme.desc: 故事描述，路天保與兩個結拜兄弟，巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人...

programme.title: 傾國傾城 / The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: 李翰祥史詩式電影，藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后；處女演出即成名的蕭瑤，飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃；而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。.

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳 / Clan Feuds
programme.desc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏，追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知，唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」，才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡，反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅，並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。.

programme.title: 港澳傳奇 / Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆，識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後，威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻；香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人，事後恬要求與石同居，結局出人意表...

programme.title: 港澳傳奇 / Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆，識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後，威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻；香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人，事後恬要求與石同居，結局出人意表...

programme.title: 奪棍 / The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: 一天，絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走，徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中，阿檬遇上雖貪財，卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下，朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍，但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。.

programme.title: 寶蓮燈 / The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事，講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘，二人一見鍾情，結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨，屢遭迫害，二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後，聞悉生母被壓華山，悲憤欲絕，藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神，劈山救母。.

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊 / The Casino
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇，二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者！.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神 / Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮，「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣，反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。.

programme.title: 水兒武士 / Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: 水兒原是大太子之私生女，流落青樓 ，二太子欲利用水兒揭大太子醜行以謀皇位。大太子不惜派殺手暗殺水兒，而二太子則命燕十三、練飛霞等護送水兒回宮。兩批人沿途激戰，水兒得武士相救避禍隱居荒村，然二人性格迥異經常引起衝突。.

programme.title: 三笑 / The Three Smiles
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香，被她所吸引，遂決定隱瞞身份，進入華家作書僮，藉此接近秋香，並向她表明自己的身份和來意，可惜秋香並不相信。最後，唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下，終於抱得美人歸。.

programme.title: 警察 / Police Force
programme.desc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕，在郊外遊玩談心時，不幸遇上歹徒劫財色，梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切，遂毅然投身警界，期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後，黃因出眾表現被升職之餘，亦與沈日久生情；不久，因一宗離奇的謀殺案件，沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手…….

programme.title: 雙鳳奇緣 / The Female Prince
programme.desc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷，滿腹經綸，卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻，夏氏貪圖富貴，強逼如龍退婚；如龍不肯，夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜，將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍，與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京，更以如龍之名赴考，一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡，乃命相國為媒，招為駙馬。洞房之夕，鳳簫向公主言明真相，並說服公主，安排一條妙計….

programme.title: 神劍震江湖 / The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」，以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎，兩人情投意合。可惜，當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後，事情也開始變得越來越複雜。.

programme.title: 紅樓夢 / Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》，被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。.

programme.title: 孔雀王朝 / Murder Plot
programme.desc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王，正值莊內嚴肅之際，其未婚妻竟無理取鬧，沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後，二人繼續追捕歡喜王，但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。.

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙 / Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境，與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局，並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中，她為躲避海關查緝，急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上，卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下，芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀，試圖奪回戒指。.

programme.title: 幪面大俠 / That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後，馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後，幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。.

programme.title: Konspirasi Rasa Penuh Tanya
programme.desc: Kiara sedang melakukan pemotretan pre wedding di sebuah butik. Tiba-tiba datang seorang pria dan ternyata pria itu kebetulan adalah mantan terindah Kiara. Bima, Bima adalah mantan terindah Kiara, SaKetika sedang membutuhkan fitting baju pengantin prianya, calon suami Kiara yang bernama Galih tidak bisa datang karena sedang sibuk syuting.Galih menyuruh Kiara untuk mencari siapa orang yang bisa menggantikannya menjadi pengantin pria. Desainer baju dan Kiara akhirnya menyuruh mantan Kiara untuk menjadi model. Sejak saat itu, Kiara dan Bima dekat hingga keduanya teringat masa lalu, tapi membuat Galih cemburu dan marah.

programme.title: Dipuji Tidak Terbang, Dicintaimu Aku Gass Bang
programme.desc: Nada sudah pacaran dengan sesama dokter, namanya Bayu, teman kuliah dulu. Saat Nada mau mengajak Bayu makan siang. Nada ke ruangan Bayu dan malah melihat bayu selingkuh dengan temannya di rumah sakit. Ingin move on dan cepat melupakan Bayu, Nada mengajukan diri untuk di pindah tugasnya. Ada anak-anak desa yang kebetulan main di sana. Nada minta tolong kepada mereka. Untuk memanggilkan kepala desanya. Harusnya kepala desa menjemput dia. Tapi mereka malah memanggil Samson. Samson sebenarnya memang diminta kepala desa, untuk menjemput dokter yang akan bertugas di puskesmas mereka.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Hilang Untuk Kembali
programme.desc: Demi merebut kembali tanah yang diambil oleh sahabat Ayahnya, Erin nekat pergi ke Bali mencari teman Ayahnya tersebut. Sesampainya disana Erin ditabrak sebuah mobil yang ternyata adalah sahabat Ayahnya yang ia cari. Erin pun menggunakan kesempatan itu dengan sebaik-baiknya sehingga ia bisa tinggal bersama Pak Hutomo. Namun niat merebut kembali surat tanah Ayahnya tersebut, Erin justru jatuh cinta dengan anak Pak Hutomo yang bernama Bagas.

programme.title: Aku Menikah Tapi Selalu Merasa Sendiri
programme.desc: Cinta (Ina Marika) terjebak dalam pernikahan penuh luka. Bagas (El Ryan), suami Cinta mengabaikan dan mengkhianati Cinta dengan berselingkuh dengan Tiara (Angbeen Rishi). Sementara Dito (Vicky Kalea) hadir membantu Cinta dengan tulus. Saat perselingkuhan terbongkar, Cinta memilih bangkit demi diri dan anaknya.

programme.title: Nayla Bukan Cinderella
programme.desc: Nayla pengusaha laundry sepatu, tiba-tiba bertemu Romy pengusaha toko sepatu. Nayla berhutang karena tak sengaja merusak handphone Romi sehingga harus bekerja di toko sepatunya. Apakah kedekatan mereka akan menimbulkan benih-benih cinta?

programme.title: Sang Pencuri Hati Di Arena Balap
programme.desc: Mita (Baiti Syaghaf) sangat suka berperahu dan menjadi pembalap perahu. Pada suatu hari, ia kehilangan perahunya menjelang ia akan balap perahu. Mita menduga pencurinya adalah Kemal (Fauzan Nasrul). Namun, Kemal melakukan hal tersebut karena suatu hal. Kemal ingat bahwa Mita adalah cinta pertamanya saat kecil. Mita yang murka tidak mau mendengarkan penjelasan Kemal.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. programme.title: Perjalanan Patah Hati
programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Awalnya perjalanan mereka menyenangkan.Namun masalah datang Ketika Mila ditemukan meninggal secara misterius meski dinyatakan meninggal akibat kecelakaan. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. programme.title: Rasa Yang Tertinggal Di Waktu Yang Salah
programme.desc: Naura (Shanice Margaretha), perawat magang yang sering ceroboh bertemu dengan Darren (Masaji Wijayanto), seorang dokter killer yang perfeksionis. Namun, siapa sangka di balik ketegasannya, Darren memiliki sisi lembut yang mampu menarik hati Naura. Sama seperti Naura, Darren pun diam-diam merasakan perasaan yang sama terhadap Naura.

programme.desc: Irene mendapatkan sebuah hadiah liburan dengan syarat harus membawa pasangan. Namun, masalah yang dihadapi Yoga dan Irene bukan hanya diteror hantu, tapi ternyata mereka pun diteror pasangan mereka yang cemburuan.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Manipulasi Rasa Hingga Terlena
programme.desc: Suasana di area sekolah riuh pikuk ketika Aaron (Kevin Ardilova) dan geng-nya tiba. Maklum aja, Aaron adalah cowok idola karena selain ganteng, dia juga famous sebagai model dan bintang iklan. Elena (Kaneishia Yusuf), si cupu berkaca-mata dengan rambut kepang dua sedang bawa keranjang kue jualannya. Saking banyaknya Elena sampai nggak bisa lihat ke depan, padahal ada Aaron and the genks yang lagi tebar pesona ke para fans. Aaron pun nabrak Elena hingga kue-kue jualan Elena jatuh ke lantai. Elena bukannya marah malah terpesona sama kegantengan Aaron yang mirip Dewa Yunani.

programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Perjalanan Patah Hati
programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Awalnya perjalanan mereka menyenangkan.Namun masalah datang Ketika Mila ditemukan meninggal secara misterius meski dinyatakan meninggal akibat kecelakaan. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: Rasa Yang Tertinggal Di Waktu Yang Salah
programme.desc: Naura (Shanice Margaretha), perawat magang yang sering ceroboh bertemu dengan Darren (Masaji Wijayanto), seorang dokter killer yang perfeksionis. Namun, siapa sangka di balik ketegasannya, Darren memiliki sisi lembut yang mampu menarik hati Naura. Sama seperti Naura, Darren pun diam-diam merasakan perasaan yang sama terhadap Naura.

Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Po-Stagram
programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Tayo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo Teman-teman~ Belajarlah untuk tumbuh menjadi anak yang sehat bersama Tayo. Mari belajar tentang pengendalian emosi, kebiasaan baik, dan keterampilan sosial bersama Tayo!

programme.title: Doby & Disy
programme.desc: Doby & Disy menyelamatkan teman-teman mereka yang terjebak dalam mimpi. Mereka bertemu Peri Mimpi & Detektif Kubi, dan bersama-sama melawan penyihir jahat yang ingin awet muda.

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib

Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Seputar Inews
programme.desc: Program berita yang menyajikan rangkuman berita-berita penting dan terkini yang terjadi di dalam dan luar negeri. Dari politik, ekonomi, hukum, hingga peristiwa sosial dan olahraga, semua dikupas tuntas di sini.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Mendadak Cinta
programme.desc: Gavin, pengusaha muda, yang muak dijodohkan, menemukan cinta pada Vior, gadis desa sederhana yang ternyata seorang artis dengan skandal pelakor. Demi membuktikan ketulusan Vior, Gavin harus mempertaruhkan bisnis dan masa depannya.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Anugerah Cinta (Rr)
programme.desc: Ayah Naura meninggalkan beban utang bagi keluarganya, yang membuat Naura dan Oki pergi ke Jakarta untuk mencari uang. Di sana, Naura bertemu dengan Arka dan mereka pun jatuh cinta, hingga akhirnya hadir orang ketiga dalam hubungan mereka.

Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Anugerah Cinta (Rr)
programme.desc: Ayah Naura meninggalkan beban utang bagi keluarganya, yang membuat Naura dan Oki pergi ke Jakarta untuk mencari uang. Di sana, Naura bertemu dengan Arka dan mereka pun jatuh cinta, hingga akhirnya hadir orang ketiga dalam hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door..., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love., NC16, rerun

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together., PG, rerun

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed., PG13, rerun

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?, NC16, rerun

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…, NC16, rerun

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…, PG13, rerun

programme.title: Loving You

During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage., NC16, rerun

programme.title: Royal Tramp II

programme.title: Mat So'od
programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.title: Perkahwinan Dari ...
programme.desc: Pasangan selebriti terkenal di Malaysia, Asha dan Mal terdesak untuk menjaga rahsia perkahwinan mereka dari diketahui oleh pengurus mereka, Feek.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Geng
programme.desc: Isabella is an ex-convict who has sworn off her life of crime. Unfortunately, her old gang boss wants her to do one last drug transaction and kidnaps her mother to blackmail Isabella. With the help of her high school best friends, Mariam and Anita, Isabella goes on a road trip to save her mother.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: 3 couples falls in love with each other in 3 different love stories.

programme.title: Boyfriend Aku Dari ...
programme.desc: After being disappointed multiple times, Risya is introduced by a friend to Andy, a nerdy young man. They fall in love but in actuality, Andy is a boyfriend from 'hell'!

programme.title: Gengster Leng Chai
programme.desc: Black is a failure of a gangster, being too soft hearted with people. After meeting Mawar, he is determined to change despite the objections of others.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Sesat Kat Paris
programme.desc: Nini and Haikal start their big adventure to find their aunty Lisa who gets a job offer as a professional photographer in Paris. Unfortunately, their journey turns upside down when they arrive in Paris and ruin a newly-wed coupleís honeymoon.

programme.title: Nota Silam
programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.
